race.comment: A couple of promising sprinters meet. Siding with the unbeaten HAZARDOUS (4) who had to dig deep to get the prize by a long neck last start over 900m at Albury. Suspect 1000m and over is going to suit her a lot more so this sets up nicely. THE SHYSTER (1) opened his career with a couple of huge wins then tackled a Class 3 over 1175m at Albury last time and found one better. Back in grade and this trip is more to his liking. Great opportunity to return to winning ways. TRAVELON DORY (6) led but folded up badly in a similar race to this at Queanbeyan recently. Tends to mix her form but if things go right she is a serious contender. SHOREMAN (11) has opened this campaign with a couple of sound efforts. Didn't get a strong 1200m at Canberra last time but dropping back to 1000m third-up looks an ideal scenario. ALICE ALICE (3) dominated in front over this distance at Albury last time out. Going through her grades nicely this prep and can be competitive again.
